answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 36663 Country: India Title: Can a person nominate his or her total property to anyone instead of his or her children Question: Can a person nominate his or her total property to anyone instead of his or her children? If yes, how the nominee will get the part of the property after his or her death? Answer ID: 36663 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 767/767/M=1433) A person can make a will of his one third property for non-heirs: وتجوز بالثلث للأجنبي عند عد م المانع ( درمختار 10 / 339 ط زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
